# Raden Hanifa — Media Portfolio

> Official media portfolio of Raden Hanifa, a media producer and cinematographer whose work spans commercial reels, aviation interviews and education, color grading, and AI filmmaking.

Raden Hanifa is also a private pilot with an instrument rating (PPL-IR) and 300 flight hours as of September 2026. His aviation media work includes interviews, pilot education, a graduation film, and color grading for OxfordSaudia Flight Academy.

This portfolio is intended for agencies, brands, aviation organizations, and hiring teams, primarily in Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and the wider GCC. These are target audiences, not claims of residence, an office, or on-location availability.

## Official portfolio pages

- [Media portfolio](https://media.radenhanifa.com): Selected commercial, aviation, color-grading, motion, and AI filmmaking work.
- [Color grading portfolio](https://media.radenhanifa.com/color-grading): Before-and-after aviation grades, selected stills, and film breakdowns.
- [OxfordSaudia interviews](https://media.radenhanifa.com/work/oxfordsaudia-interviews): Student and captain interview case study covering scripting, direction, cinematography, editing, motion titles, and dialogue polishing.
- [OxfordSaudia aviation education](https://media.radenhanifa.com/work/oxfordsaudia-educational-series): Pilot-education case study covering scripting, direction, filming, editing, and audio finishing.
- [Expanded portfolio reference](https://media.radenhanifa.com/llms-full.txt): Detailed factual summary of Raden Hanifa's work, credits, and identity links.
